Dareful design reference

Every board on the canvas, drawn inline at full size with no scripts, so this file opens anywhere. The interactive boards are drawn in their first state; on the canvas they play, and the motion boards beside them draw each transition frame by frame. The information sheets and the opening (sections 10 and 11) have a row of their own under the motion rows. The last three rows are pass the phone (scheduled for the round after this one), multi-choice (for the contract redeploy) and the light theme (section 8).

docs/design.md is the specification and wins wherever a board differs. The screens are specified there in words (3.24, 3.25, 3.37, 3.38), so nothing here is needed to build them.
